evidence_policy: A vector is accepted only with exact source/artifact identity, command argv/cwd, runtime, operation/readback or fixture output, and an explicit pass/fail/unsupported/unmeasured disposition. Historical evidence is not silently reused.

vector_schema.record_model: The canonical vector record is the deterministic join of one detailed vectors row and one vector_metadata row by id; a missing, duplicate, or conflicting join is invalid.

vectors.subject: task status decision
vectors.preconditions: same canonical snapshot, policy, graph, gates, attempt and as_of
vectors.expected: deterministic primary status, ordered reasons, actor actions and next_status_change_at
vectors.evidence: structural/domain fixture plus later service parity

vectors.subject: queued versus blocked precedence
vectors.preconditions: normal open prerequisite versus intervention/recovery hold
vectors.expected: queued only for ordinary prerequisite waiting; blocked for named intervention; both reasons retained

vectors.subject: server action descriptors
vectors.preconditions: actor role and target revision supplied
vectors.expected: allowed/denied actions come from the service and carry revisions, fence, confirmation and recovery

vectors.subject: expiry, pause, retry and schedule timers
vectors.preconditions: exact as_of at and around deadline
vectors.expected: expired_review/blocked or retry_wait/scheduled mapping is stable and never grants authority
vectors.evidence: virtual-clock fixture plus native timer gate

vectors.subject: principal/role boundary
vectors.preconditions: agent, reviewer, operator and publisher credentials
vectors.expected: foreign role and forged actor identity rejected with typed error and audit outcome

vectors.subject: transactional mutation race
vectors.preconditions: two actors use same work/revision or dependency mutation concurrently
vectors.expected: one valid commit, conflicts/denials for the rest, no partial mutation or duplicate side effect

vectors.subject: operation interruption/readback
vectors.preconditions: interrupt before and after commit-before-response
vectors.expected: unknown until operation ID/digest readback, then one committed/rejected result; retry does not duplicate

vectors.subject: immutable profile and pinned requirements
vectors.preconditions: create task, delete/alter gate observation or parent default
vectors.expected: required declaration remains detectable; child pin does not silently change

vectors.subject: receipt subject/source/gate integrity
vectors.preconditions: wrong command, subject, source, config, exit, attestation or gate
vectors.expected: typed rejection; failed fact retained; no accepted proof

vectors.subject: review and closeout
vectors.preconditions: required review absent/rejected/stale or close intent mismatch
vectors.expected: awaiting_review, blocked, or closeout pending; rejected review remains intervention; accepted close commits once

vectors.subject: typed exception
vectors.preconditions: authorized operator exception against exact requirement/edge/revision
vectors.expected: raw failed/unmet fact remains plus scoped reason, principal, expiry, impact digest and audit

vectors.subject: dependency satisfaction
vectors.preconditions: upstream complete/verified/cancelled versus accepted closed
vectors.expected: only accepted closed satisfies default edge; cancellation remains unsatisfied

vectors.subject: cycle prevention and waiver
vectors.preconditions: add graph cycle or waive one edge
vectors.expected: cycle rejected atomically; waiver preserves edge and records scoped decision

vectors.subject: milestone/task/cycle assignment
vectors.preconditions: two cycles, cross-cycle dependency, queued children, carry-over
vectors.expected: task identity/milestone parent stable; one live assignment; activation and rollup revisioned

vectors.subject: container rollup
vectors.preconditions: mixed accepted, queued, blocked, cancelled and deferred descendants
vectors.expected: exact accepted/scope/reconciliation totals with no task-shaped fabricated attempt

vectors.subject: row/scope quarantine
vectors.preconditions: malformed clock/profile/gate/parent/foreign reference
vectors.expected: valid siblings remain visible; affected scope diagnostic/quarantined; forward writes disabled

vectors.subject: dashboard/rollup integrity
vectors.preconditions: damaged parent or unreadable descendant during project snapshot
vectors.expected: exact or explicitly incomplete totals; no fallback project or fabricated counts

vectors.subject: project binding and late response
vectors.preconditions: two roots with overlapping IDs, copied metadata, symlink/.., project switch
vectors.expected: no cross-project read/mutation/cache/subscription; late A response cannot repaint B

vectors.subject: restore epoch
vectors.preconditions: restore/clone/copy then stale client/operation/fence
vectors.expected: new explicit identity/epoch outcome; stale operation rejected/readback isolated

vectors.subject: v1 disposition
vectors.preconditions: legacy done/complete/archived/failed/verified/cancelled with missing proof
vectors.expected: historical status/provenance preserved; only valid accepted close satisfies v2 dependency

vectors.subject: guided v1 parity
vectors.preconditions: unfamiliar agent no goal, then plan/claim/evidence/finish/next
vectors.expected: discoverable safe next action and explicit limitations without bespoke prompt or CRUD bypass

vectors.subject: workflow/directive discovery
vectors.preconditions: list/show unknown and known assets
vectors.expected: versioned typed inputs/argv/cwd/runner, no shell eval, unknown fails closed

vectors.subject: bounded context and next
vectors.preconditions: no-goal, stale context, blocked/queued/expired work
vectors.expected: project/revision bounded guidance, safe action, reason and recovery; no fabricated command

vectors.subject: responsive diagnostic dashboard
vectors.preconditions: 80x24, 100x32, 144x40, resize/dialog, corrupt/unavailable service
vectors.expected: stable identity, red diagnostic/quarantine state, disabled unsafe actions, no direct DB read
vectors.evidence: PTY plus real service for product claim

vectors.subject: service restart and maintenance election
vectors.preconditions: restart with active attempt/subscription/pending operation
vectors.expected: one owner, no lock break, readback/resnapshot, stale fence rejected

vectors.subject: deadline exactness
vectors.preconditions: as_of before, at, after lease/hard deadline
vectors.expected: at/after expires, heartbeat cannot extend hard budget, next timer authoritative

vectors.subject: physical expiry recovery
vectors.preconditions: worker remains alive after expiry, shared resource exists
vectors.expected: old fence blocked, durable recovery obligation retained, resource not reused until safe

vectors.subject: failed evidence and attempt retention
vectors.preconditions: failed receipt, rejected review, superseded outcome, retry
vectors.expected: append-only history/readback retained and excluded from current acceptance by explicit rule

vectors.subject: revision/fence separation
vectors.preconditions: unrelated heartbeat/planning edit/review and stale entity/proof revision
vectors.expected: only relevant revision invalidates action; fence still revokes old executor

vectors.subject: server action authorization
vectors.preconditions: client requests an action not in the server descriptor or lacks its role/fence/revision
vectors.expected: typed rejection with denied action, reason, recovery route and no mutation

vectors.subject: cycle carry-over
vectors.preconditions: task has a historical assignment in cycle A and is committed to cycle B
vectors.expected: old assignment is ended, successor assignment is linked, task/milestone identity is stable, no duplicate live assignment

vectors.subject: proof-gated close
vectors.preconditions: finish/close intent with missing, stale, failed or accepted required gates
vectors.expected: only valid proof/review/exception for the same subject and revision can commit closed; otherwise typed closeout gap

vectors.subject: override scope and revocation
vectors.preconditions: operator exception targets wrong project, revision, gate, edge, or expired scope
vectors.expected: unauthorized/stale override rejected; original failure remains and downstream impact is reported

vectors.subject: planning graph validation
vectors.preconditions: create/edit milestone, task, profile, dependency, or cycle with invalid parent, cycle, missing requirement, or duplicate assignment
vectors.expected: valid plan commits one revision; invalid plan is rejected atomically with actionable diagnostics

vectors.subject: profile version selection
vectors.preconditions: parent default changes or profile definition/gate row is deleted/corrupt after task pin
vectors.expected: task continues to use its immutable pinned profile; missing definition quarantines rather than appearing gate-free

vectors.subject: reopen proof generation
vectors.preconditions: authorized reopen targets previously accepted outcome with downstream dependents
vectors.expected: new proof generation and impact assessment; old approval remains historical and is not silently reused

vectors.subject: backup restore identity
vectors.preconditions: restore database/blobs/memory manifest while clients, attempts or operations exist
vectors.expected: consistent restore, new restore epoch, stale clients/fences rejected, missing references reported

vectors.subject: independent review decision
vectors.preconditions: attempt actor, stale submission, wrong project, or unauthorized reviewer submits approve/reject
vectors.expected: self/stale/foreign review rejected; valid independent decision is append-only and subject-bound
vectors.evidence: real reviewer identity and submission readback

vectors.subject: scope reconciliation rollup
vectors.preconditions: container has accepted, deferred, cancelled, blocked and unreadable descendants
vectors.expected: accepted work and reconciled scope are reported separately; totals are exact or explicitly incomplete
vectors.evidence: real planning snapshot with corruption fixture

vectors.subject: legal lifecycle transition
vectors.preconditions: attempted status/phase transition with current authority, stale fence, missing proof, or hard hold
vectors.expected: legal transition emits deterministic result; illegal transition returns typed reason and no partial write
vectors.evidence: domain vectors plus transactional service test

vectors.subject: oracle integrity
vectors.preconditions: matrix row missing required field or claims pass without evidence
vectors.expected: validator rejects missing vector/obligation/owner/evidence state

vectors.subject: contract identity drift
vectors.preconditions: artifact digest, protocol target, or source ref changes
vectors.expected: manifest/contract validator identifies drift; no silent compatibility relabel

vectors.subject: N/N-1 compatibility
vectors.preconditions: old client/new service and new client/old service with target fields
vectors.expected: lossless reads where mapped; writes fail closed when policy/capability absent

vectors.subject: end-to-end lifecycle
vectors.preconditions: fresh project, milestone/cycle/task, claim/start/evidence/finish/review/release
vectors.expected: genuine receipts, accepted close only after proof, release path preserves history, operation readback exact
vectors.evidence: actual built Rust service and supported clients

vectors.subject: target build/test/runtime floor
vectors.preconditions: clean tag and target runner
vectors.expected: locked tests/build, actual SQLite >=3.51.3, manifest/source/binary/TUI identities match

vectors.subject: install/upgrade/rollback
vectors.preconditions: archive, BSD/GNU tar, disposable prefix, interrupted activation/restore
vectors.expected: complete payload installs, rollback is recoverable, wrong/incompatible package rejected, no shell-profile mutation

vectors.subject: sprint review/reconciliation/revalidation
vectors.preconditions: all leaves and evidence at one integrated source identity
vectors.expected: findings attributable, mandatory issues fixed, exact-tree checks rerun, only T92 unlocks successors

vectors.subject: contract artifact review
vectors.preconditions: bounded artifact and evidence complete
vectors.expected: reviewer accepts only artifact boundary and records authority limits

vectors.subject: failed attempt preservation
vectors.preconditions: worker timeout/review rejection
vectors.expected: interrupted/rejected attempt remains visible; takeover uses a new attempt
